title: Welcome to S.Y. 2026-2027!
body: Welcome back, students! Classes officially begin on August 15, 2026. Please check your schedules and prepare your modules accordingly.

title: First Quarterly Examination Schedule
body: The first quarterly examinations are scheduled from September 15-19, 2026. Please review your subjects accordingly. Examination permits will be released a week before the exam.

title: ABM 11-A: Class Meeting on Friday
body: There will be a class meeting this Friday, August 29, 2026 at 3:00 PM in SHS-501 to discuss the upcoming business simulation activity.

title: Library Hours Update
body: The school library will now be open from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday, and 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM on Saturdays.

title: Guidance Office: Free Counseling Sessions
body: The Guidance Office is now offering free counseling sessions every Wednesday and Friday afternoon. Walk-ins are welcome.

title: Reminder: Submit IDs
body: All ABM 11-A students are reminded to submit their 2x2 ID photos to the homeroom adviser on or before August 30.

title: Intramurals 2026
body: The annual intramurals will be held from October 5-9, 2026. Start forming your teams and coordinate with the PE department.
